purpose: Public-safe deterministic benchmark catalog for comparing observable Raw Agent vs governed-agent decisions.
claims_boundary: Evaluation tooling only; not a safety certification, formal certification, third-party validation claim, medical claim, or machine-consciousness claim.
privacy_boundary: Contains only public benchmark scenarios. No protected GHOSBC kernel internals, hidden policies, private prompts, credentials, cipher/language mappings, or reconstruction material.
